To Set Which Report Need to Be Sent.label: To Set Which Report Need to Be Sent
To Set Which Report Need to Be Sent.description: This parameter is used to configure which reports need to be sent in report group 1. the values corresponding to the first four bits of the parameter value may be combined to create different combinations of reports that you wish to have sent. for example, instantaneous current is the value 2 and instantaneous watts is the value 4, so setting parameter 101 to a value of 6 will result in both instantaneous current and instantaneous watts to be reported. see the full description of the parameter values for other possible settings

Make Smart Switch Blink.label: Make Smart Switch Blink
Make Smart Switch Blink.description: This parameter is used for customer to control the product’s load (e. g incandescent light) to blink with a certain time when you set this parameter and send this command to the load

Enable/Disable Lock Configuration.label: Enable/Disable Lock Configuration
Enable/Disable Lock Configuration.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable lock all configuration parameters. (0 =disable, 1 = enable)

Reset to Default Factory Setting.label: Reset to Default Factory Setting
Reset to Default Factory Setting.description: This parameter is used to reset product to default factory setting. (there are just 2 values can be used)

Enable/Disable to Send Notifications to.label: Enable/Disable to Send Notifications to Associated Devices to Associated Devices
Enable/Disable to Send Notifications to.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable to send notifications to associated devices (in group 1) when the state of smart switch gen5’s load is changed.  (0=send nothing, 1=send hail cc, 2=send basic report cc)

Partner Id.label: Partner Id
Partner Id.description: This parameter is used to configure the partner id.  (0== aeon labs standard product, 1~255== others)

Current Overload Protection.label: Current Overload Protection
Current Overload Protection.description: This parameter is used for the overload protection, which means the load will be disconnected after 2 minutes when the current more than 15.5a

Enable/Disable The Function of Parameter.label: Enable/Disable The Function of Parameter 91 And 92
Enable/Disable The Function of Parameter.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable the function of parameter 91 and 92 (1=enabled, 0=disabled)

Auto Report When The Change of Wattage S.label: Auto Report When The Change of Wattage Surpasses The Set Percentage

Alarm 3 Specifications.label: Alarm 3 Specifications
Alarm 3 Specifications.description: To set-up your values please follow this link : www.nodon.fr/support/asp3/alarm

Alarm 4 Specifications.label: Alarm 4 Specifications
Alarm 4 Specifications.description: To set-up your values please follow this link : www.nodon.fr/support/asp3/alarm

Alarm 6 Specifications.label: Alarm 6 Specifications
Alarm 6 Specifications.description: To set-up your values please follow this link : www.nodon.fr/support/asp3/alarm

Alarm 7 Specifications.label: Alarm 7 Specifications
Alarm 7 Specifications.description: To set-up your values please follow this link : www.nodon.fr/support/asp3/alarm

Follow State.label: Follow State
Follow State.description: This parameter allows to enable or deactivate group 2 & group 3. the value may be the sum of available values. for example, if you want to enable group 2 & 3, the parameter value is 1+2=3

Alarm 1 Type Configuration.label: Alarm 1 Type Configuration
Alarm 1 Type Configuration.description: To set-up your values please follow this link : www.nodon.fr/support/asp3/alarm

Alarm 2 Type Configuration.label: Alarm 2 Type Configuration
Alarm 2 Type Configuration.description: To set-up your values please follow this link : www.nodon.fr/support/asp3/alarm

Alarm 3 Type Configuration.label: Alarm 3 Type Configuration
Alarm 3 Type Configuration.description: To set-up your values please follow this link : www.nodon.fr/support/asp3/alarm

Button 1 And 3 Pair Mode.label: Button 1 And 3 Pair Mode
Button 1 And 3 Pair Mode.description: In separate mode button 1 works with group a, button 3 with groups c. click is on, hold is dimming up, double click is off, click-hold is dimming down. in pair button 1/3 are up/down correspondingly. click is on/off, hold is dimming up/down. single clicks works with group a, double click with group c

Command to Control Group B.label: Command to Control Group B
Command to Control Group B.description: This parameter defines the command to be sent to devices of control group b when the related button is pressed

Command to Control Group D.label: Command to Control Group D
Command to Control Group D.description: This parameter defines the command to be sent to devices of control group d when the related button is pressed

Send The Following Switch All Commands.label: Send The Following Switch All Commands

Blocks Wakeup Even When Wakeup Interval.label: Blocks Wakeup Even When Wakeup Interval is Set

Led Indicator.label: Led Indicator
Led Indicator.description: This parameter controls the state of the LED indicator with regard to the on/off state of the wall switch

Watt Meter Report Period.label: Watt Meter Report Period
Watt Meter Report Period.description: This configuration parameter determines how often meter reporting of instantaneous watt usage is reported automatically. each unit is 5 seconds. the maximum interval to report its instant power consumption is 45 hours (5s*32767/3600=45hr)

Mode of Switch Off Function.label: Mode of Switch Off Function
Mode of Switch Off Function.description: This configuration parameter determines how the switch will respond to a received switch off command

Auto Off Timer.label: Auto Off Timer
Auto Off Timer.description: Automatic shut-off setting. this parameter determines the amount of time before the switch is automatically turned off after it has been turned on

Operation Mode.label: Operation Mode
Operation Mode.description: Operation mode. using bit to control. bit0: reserve. bit1: 1 means test mode,   0 means normal mode. notice:  this bit only effect by the dip switch setting to “customer mode”, otherwise it decides by dip switch setting to test or normal mode. bit2: reserve. bit3: setting the temperature scale.  0: fahrenheit, 1:celsius bit4: disable the illumination report after event triggered. (1:disable, 0:enable) bit5: disable the temperature report after event triggered. (1:disable, 0:enable) bit6: reserve. bit7: disable the back key release into test mode. (1:disable, 0:enable) notice: the reserve bit is allowed any value, but no effect

Configure The Siren Sound And Its Volume.label: Configure The Siren Sound And Its Volume
Configure The Siren Sound And Its Volume.description: This parameter is used to configure the siren sound and volume as the default setting

Command to Control Group A.label: Command to Control Group A
Command to Control Group A.description: This parameter defines the command to be sent to devices of control group a when the related button is pressed

Button 2 And 4 Pair Mode.label: Button 2 And 4 Pair Mode
Button 2 And 4 Pair Mode.description: In separate mode button 2 works with control group b, button 4 with control group d. click is on, hold is dimming up, double click is off, click-hold is dimming down. in pair button b/d are up/down correspondingly. click is on/off, hold is dimming up/down. single clicks works with group b, double click with group d

Send Unsolicited Battery Report On Wake.label: Send Unsolicited Battery Report On Wake Up

Existence of Endpoint3.label: Existence of Endpoint3
Existence of Endpoint3.description: Multi-channel command is a good way to control relay1 and relay2 of pan04 individually. the endpoint3 of pan04 is related to both relay1 and relay2. in some condition it becomes redundant in multi-channel command class. when the existence of endpoint3 is set as 2, the endpoint3 will be disabled. the default value is 1.  endpoint1 and endpoint2 are fixed, only endpoint3 is dynamic

Edge Or Pulse Mode Or Edge-toggl E Mode.label: Edge Or Pulse Mode Or Edge-toggl E Mode
Edge Or Pulse Mode Or Edge-toggl E Mode.description: Edge mode: this mode is suitable for the bi stable wall switch that has indicator point on the switch, and the same position correspond to same state of relay1 and relay2. if the pan04 relay change the state because of receiving Z-Wave rf command, it may need two times of change (switch on to off or switch off to on) to let relay back to the correspond state. pulse mode: this mode is suitable for the toggle type wall switch to swap the state of relay1 or relay2.  edge-toggle mode: this mode is suitable for the normal bi-stable switch, every time when change the state of the wall switch will also swap the state of relay1 or relay2

Rf Off Command Mode.label: Rf Off Command Mode
Rf Off Command Mode.description: Whenever a switch off command, basic_set 、 binary_switch_set 、 switch_all_off, is received, it could be interpreted as 4 kinds of commands.  1. switch off ： it switches to off state. the default setting is switch off.  2. ignore ： the switch off command will be ignored.  3. switch toggle ： it switches to the inverse of current state.  4. switch on ： it switches to on state

Customer Function.label: Customer Function
Customer Function.description: Customer function switch, using bit control. bit0: reserve. bit1: reserve. bit2: reserve. bit3: disable send out basic off after door closed. (1:disable, 0:enable) bit4: notification type,   0: using notification report.   1: using sensor binary report. bit5: disable multi cc in auto report. (1:disable, 0:enable) bit6: disable to report battery state when the device triggered. (1:disable, 0:enable) bit7: reserve. notice: the reserve bit is allowed any value, but no effect

Temperature Display Units.label: Temperature Display Units
Temperature Display Units.description: This parameter controls what thermostat units are displayed on the thermostat screen. it is independent of the temperature units used on the Z-Wave network

Configurable Terminal Setting.label: Configurable Terminal Setting
Configurable Terminal Setting.description: Control the function of the configurable terminal on the thermostat

Remote Temperature Enable.label: Remote Temperature Enable
Remote Temperature Enable.description: If enabled, the thermostat will use the remote temperature instead of the local measured value

Z-Wave Echo Association Reports.label: Z-Wave Echo Association Reports
Z-Wave Echo Association Reports.description: When enabled, the thermostat will report all changes to the thermostat mode, thermostat fan mode, and thermostat setpoint, even when change was caused by commands from Z-Wave

Which Report Needs to Be Sent in Report.label: Which Report Needs to Be Sent in Report Group 2
Which Report Needs to Be Sent in Report.description: This parameter is used to configure to send the humidity sensor, thermometer, light sensor and battery reports automatically in report group 2. note: the values corresponding to the first four bits of the parameter value may be combined to create different combinations of reports that you wish to have sent. for example, the temperature sensor report is the value 32 and the battery report is the value 1, so setting parameter 102 to a value of 33 will result in both temperature sensor report and battery report to be reported. see the full description of the parameter values for other possible settings

Enable/Disable Waking Up For 10 Minutes.label: Enable/Disable Waking Up For 10 Minutes When Re-power On (battery Mode) The Multisensor
Enable/Disable Waking Up For 10 Minutes.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable waking up for 10 minutes when re-power on (battery mode) the multisensor. 1. value = 0, disable. 2. value =others, enable

Timeout of The Motion Sensor.label: Timeout of The Motion Sensor
Timeout of The Motion Sensor.description: This parameter is used to set the timeout for the motion sensor.  note: (1), the time unit is second if the value range is in 1 to 255.  (2), if the value range is in 256 to 15300, the time unit will be minute and its value should follow the below rules: a), interval time =value/60, if the interval time can be divided by 60 and without remainder. b), interval time= (value/60) +1, if the interval time can be divided by 60 and has remainder. (3), other values will be ignored

Enable/Disable The Selective Reporting O.label: Enable/Disable The Selective Reporting Only When Measurements Reach a Certain Threshold Or Percentage Set in 41-44 Below
Enable/Disable The Selective Reporting O.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable the selective reporting only when measurements reach a certain threshold or percentage set in the parameter 41 to 44. this is used to reduce network traffic.  (0 == disable, 1 == enable)

Which Command Would Be Sent When The Mot.label: Which Command Would Be Sent When The Motion Sensor Triggered
Which Command Would Be Sent When The Mot.description: This parameter is used to configure that which command would be sent when the motion sensor triggered. 1. value=1, send Basic Set cc. 2. value=2, send sensor binary report cc

Level Report Mode.label: Level Report Mode
Level Report Mode.description: There two modes of reporting the level of pan08 while moving the shutter

Reset The Configuration Parameter to Def.label: Reset The Configuration Parameter to Default Factory Setting
Reset The Configuration Parameter to Def.description: Resets all configuration parameters to default setting

Alarm Duration.label: Alarm Duration
Alarm Duration.description: Play alarm sound duration, 1 tick is 30 seconds. default is 3 minutes, maximum is 63.5 minutes 0: means never auto stop

Selected Relay.label: Selected Relay
Selected Relay.description: If controller not using multi_channel command class to access the relay of pan06, you may configure the select value to react the basic command class or binary switch command class

Restore Switch State Mode.label: Restore Switch State Mode
Restore Switch State Mode.description: Whenever the ac power return from lost, pan06 will restore the switch state which could be switch off、last switch state、switch on. the default setting is last switch state

Brakeandgoback.label: Brakeandgoback
Brakeandgoback.description: 0 = disabled. 1-15 seconds to brake. when used the lock will brake for x amount of seconds and then turn 75 degrees back. made for special doors without door lever.(only when unlatching)

Door Lock Operation Report Type.label: Door Lock Operation Report Type
Door Lock Operation Report Type.description: 0 = simple supported by all controllers that support door locks. 1 = advanced, more specific reports through notification command class. 2 = no door lock operation reports are sent unsolicited

Mode.label: Mode
Mode.description: 0 = stepper motor mode wave drive(power saving) 1 = stepper motor mode full drive(normal) 2 = relay mode

Sound.label: Sound
Sound.description: Disable or enable the beep sound from latch or unlatch operations(0 = disable, 1 = enable.)

Battery Alarm Value.label: Battery Alarm Value
Battery Alarm Value.description: When the battery level is equal to or under this value, the device will notify user with a beep sound after latch or unlatch

Led.label: Led
Led.description: When shipped from the factory, the LED is set to turn on when the connected light is turned off. this allows the LED to indicate the switch’s location in a dark room. to make the LED turn on when the light is turned on, change parameter 3’s value to 1, to turn the LED off at all times, change parameter 3’s value to 2

Configuration Reset.label: Configuration Reset
Configuration Reset.description: Defines which parameters should be reset to default values

Led Light.label: Led Light
Led Light.description: When shipped from the factory, the LED is set to turn on when the connected light is turned off. this is the default setting and can be changed if your primary controller supports the node configuration function. to make the LED turn on when the light is turned on, change parameter 3’s value to “1”. to turn the LED off at all times, change parameter 3’s value to 2

Basic Set Off Level.label: Basic Set Off Level
Basic Set Off Level.description: Control the value represented by the left-side in area d

Configure The Output Load Status After R.label: Configure The Output Load Status After Re-power On
Configure The Output Load Status After R.description: Configure the output load status after re-power on the smart switch

Change The Color Value of RGB LED For Te.label: Change The Color Value of RGB LED For Testing
Change The Color Value of RGB LED For Te.description: This parameter is only used for customer checking/testing the product's RGB color via changing the RGB values

Configure The LED Indication Status When.label: Configure The LED Indication Status When It is in Night Light Mode
Configure The LED Indication Status When.description: This parameter is used to configure the LED indication status when the current mode is night light mode

Enable/Disable The Function of Using Ext.label: Enable/Disable The Function of Using External Switch to Turn On/Off The Bulbs Color
Enable/Disable The Function of Using Ext.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable the function of using external switch to turn on/off the bulb's color

Buttons 1&3 Profile.label: Buttons 1&3 Profile
Buttons 1&3 Profile.description: This parameter configures the behavior of the buttons 1 and 3 when the product is in “gateway" mode

Scene Type.label: Scene Type
Scene Type.description: This parameter configures the type of command sent when the product is in “gateway centric mode”, with buttons profile configuration set in scene.   we strongly advise you to use « central scene », which is more user friendly. however, some home automation gateways don’t support « central scene » yet, then you can still use the previous standard « scene activation ».   the user interface of your gateway will then allow you to set-up scenes.  note: if parameter n°1 or n°2 is not set in scene, then this parameter is ignored

Button 2 Configuration.label: Button 2 Configuration
Button 2 Configuration.description: This parameter configures the behavior of the button 2 in “gateway" mode, when set in mono (refers parameter n°1 – buttons 2&4 profile)  note: if parameter n°2 is not set in mono, then this parameter is ignored

Button 4 Configuration.label: Button 4 Configuration
Button 4 Configuration.description: This parameter configures the behavior of the button 4 in “gateway" mode, when set in mono (refers parameter n°1 – buttons 2&4 profile)  note: if parameter n°2 is not set in mono, then this parameter is ignored

Hvac Settings.label: Hvac Settings
Hvac Settings.description: Byte 1: normal (1) or heat pump (2). byte 2, bits 7-4: gas (1) or electric (2). byte 2, bits 3-0: # of auxiliary stages. byte 3: # of heat pump stages. byte 4: # of cool stages

Thermostat Differential Temperature.label: Thermostat Differential Temperature
Thermostat Differential Temperature.description: The thermostat differential temperature configuration command sets the differential temperature for multi-stage hvac systems

Activate / Deactivate Functions All On/A.label: Activate / Deactivate Functions All On/All Off
Activate / Deactivate Functions All On/A.description: Support to activate / deactivate functions all on/all off flush 1d relay module responds to commands all on / all off that may be sent by the main controller or by other controller belonging to the system

Automatic Turning On Output After Set Ti.label: Automatic Turning On Output After Set Time
Automatic Turning On Output After Set Ti.description: Support automatic turning on output after set time  when relay is off it goes automatically on after time defined by this parameter. timer is reset to zero each time the module receive off command regardless from where it comes (push button, associated module, controller,..)

Automatic Turning Off / On Seconds Or Mi.label: Automatic Turning Off / On Seconds Or Milliseconds Selection
Automatic Turning Off / On Seconds Or Mi.description: Support automatic turning off / on seconds or milliseconds selection note: this parameter is valid for both, turning on and turning off parameters

Saving The State of The Relay After a Po.label: Saving The State of The Relay After a Power Failure
Saving The State of The Relay After a Po.description: Support saving the state of the relay after a power failure

Enable/Disable Security Network.label: Enable/Disable Security Network
Enable/Disable Security Network.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable security network

Enable/Disable The LED Indicator.label: Enable/Disable The LED Indicator
Enable/Disable The LED Indicator.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable the LED indicator

Associations in Z-Wave Network Security.label: Associations in Z-Wave Network Security Mode
Associations in Z-Wave Network Security.description: This parameter defines how commands are sent in specified association groups: as secure or non-secure. parameter is active only in Z-Wave network security mode. it does not apply to 1st “lifeline “group

Enable/Disable The Configuration Paramet.label: Enable/Disable The Configuration Parameters to Be Locked
Enable/Disable The Configuration Paramet.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable the configuration parameters to be locked. (0== disable, 1== enable)

2nd Association Group Triggers.label: 2nd Association Group Triggers
2nd Association Group Triggers.description: Parameter defines events which result in sending on/off commands to devices added to the 2nd association group. these commands are sent alternately to switch the devices on and off. commands represent the values of Basic Set command frames. parameter is inactive in external button mode (parameter 1 set to 1)

Value of On Command Frame Sent to 2nd As.label: Value of On Command Frame Sent to 2nd Association Group
Value of On Command Frame Sent to 2nd As.description: The value of 0 turns off the device, 255 turns it on. in case of associating the dimmer or roller shutter module, values 1-99 allow to set an associated device to a specified level

Time Delay of Off Command Frame.label: Time Delay of Off Command Frame

Reporting Tamper Alarm Cancellation.label: Reporting Tamper Alarm Cancellation
Reporting Tamper Alarm Cancellation.description: Reporting the cancellation of tamper alarm to 5th association group

Interval of Temperature Measuring.label: Interval of Temperature Measuring
Interval of Temperature Measuring.description: This parameter defines how often the temperature will be measured. the shorter the time, the more frequently the temperature will be measured, but the battery life will shorten

Invert Switch.label: Invert Switch
Invert Switch.description: If the switch is accidentally installed upside down with “on” at the bottom and “off” at the top, the default on/off rocker settings can be reversed by changing parameter 4’s value to “1”

Enable/Disable The Function of Using Ext.label: Enable/Disable The Function of Using External Switch to Turn On/Off The Bulb
Enable/Disable The Function of Using Ext.description: This parameter is used to enable/disable the function of using external switch to turn on/off the bulb

Button 3 Configuration.label: Button 3 Configuration
Button 3 Configuration.description: To set-up the how button 3 behaves, when set in mono profie

To Set Which Report Would Be Sent in Rep.label: To Set Which Report Would Be Sent in Report Group 1
To Set Which Report Would Be Sent in Rep.description: To set which report would be sent in report group 1.  note: you can also set all sensor reports to be sent out at the same time. e.g. if you want the batter report and temperature report to be sent out at the same time, you just need to set the configuration value to 33 (1+32)

To Set Which Report Would Be Sent in Rep.label: To Set Which Report Would Be Sent in Report Group 3
To Set Which Report Would Be Sent in Rep.description: To set which report would be sent in report group 3. note: you can also set all sensor reports to be sent out at the same time. e.g. if you want the batter report and temperature report to be sent out at the same time, you just need to set the configuration value to 33 (1+32)

Set The Sensitivity of The Motion Sensor.label: Set The Sensitivity of The Motion Sensor
Set The Sensitivity of The Motion Sensor.description: This parameter changes the sensitivity level of the motion detector

Enable/Disable to Send The Alarm Report.label: Enable/Disable to Send The Alarm Report of Low Temperature
Enable/Disable to Send The Alarm Report.description: Enable/disable to send the alarm report of low temperature(<-15℃). note: if it is enabled, the multisensor will send a report of multi level temperature cc to controller when the current temperature is less than -15℃)

Set The Recover Limit Value of Ultraviol.label: Set The Recover Limit Value of Ultraviolet Sensor
Set The Recover Limit Value of Ultraviol.description: Set the recover limit value of ultraviolet sensor. note: 1. when the current measurement <= (upper limit – recover limit), the upper limit report is enabled and then it would send out a sensor report when the next measurement is more than the upper limit. after that the upper limit report would be disabled again until the measurement <= (upper limit – recover limit). 2. when the current measurement >= (lower limit + recover limit), the lower limit report is enabled and then it would send out a sensor report when the next measurement is less than the lower limit. after that the lower limit report would be disabled again until the measurement >= (lower limit + recover limit)

Set The Default Unit of The Automatic Te.label: Set The Default Unit of The Automatic Temperature Report in Parameter 101-103
Set The Default Unit of The Automatic Te.description: Set the default unit of the automatic temperature report in parameter 101-103

Report The Current Power Mode And The Pr.label: Report The Current Power Mode And The Product State For Battery Power Mode
Report The Current Power Mode And The Pr.description: Report the current power mode and the product state for battery power mode. note: this parameter cannot be used as set usage

Dim Rate Adjustments (when Manually Cont.label: Dim Rate Adjustments (when Manually Contolled)
Dim Rate Adjustments (when Manually Cont.description: Please note: values should be entered using their signed values only, which means for example that a configuration value of 1 byte in size must have values in the range -128 to 127. values specified here above or below the range specified by the value's size need to be converted to their 2's compliment value, or if your controller supports it, may be entered using hexadecimal notation

Dim Rate Adjustments (when Receiving All.label: Dim Rate Adjustments (when Receiving All-on/All-off Command)
Dim Rate Adjustments (when Receiving All.description: Timing of the steps please note: values should be entered using their signed values only, which means for example that a configuration value of 1 byte in size must have values in the range -128 to 127. values specified here above or below the range specified by the value's size need to be converted to their 2's compliment value, or if your controller supports it, may be entered using hexadecimal notation

Dim Rate Adjustments (from Z-Wave Contro.label: Dim Rate Adjustments (from Z-Wave Controller)
Dim Rate Adjustments (from Z-Wave Contro.description: Timing of steps please note: values should be entered using their singed values only, which means for example that a configuration value of 1 byte in size must have values in the range -128 to 127. values specified here above or below the range specified by the values size need to be converted to their 2's compliment value, or if your controller supports it, may be entered using hexadecimal notation

Dim Level When The Light Bulb is Turned.label: Dim Level When The Light Bulb is Turned On
Dim Level When The Light Bulb is Turned.description: You may select the dim level whenever the light is turned back on to be either full brightness (100% dim level) or be the same as the last dim setting when the light was previously on

Configuration Report For The Tamper Swit.label: Configuration Report For The Tamper Switch State
Configuration Report For The Tamper Swit.description: This parameter is used to report the state when the sensor is installed on the garage door or removed from the garage door. note: the state would be reported via configuration report cc

Start Playing Or Stop Playing The Ringto.label: Start Playing Or Stop Playing The Ringtone
Start Playing Or Stop Playing The Ringto.description: This parameter is used to audition or test the product's ringtone

Get The Environment Temperature.label: Get The Environment Temperature
Get The Environment Temperature.description: The available temperature range is 0 to 50 celsius

Type of Signals to Association Group 2.label: Type of Signals to Association Group 2
Type of Signals to Association Group 2.description: When this configuration is set to inverted, an off-signal will be sent when the sensor is opened and on-signal when it's closed instead of the opposite

Set The Interval Time of Battery Report.label: Set The Interval Time of Battery Report
Set The Interval Time of Battery Report.description: This parameter is used to set the interval time of battery report

Reset The Sensor.label: Reset The Sensor
Reset The Sensor.description: This parameter is used to reset the sensor

Siren Tamper Mode.label: Siren Tamper Mode
Siren Tamper Mode.description: Sets the tamper triggering mode when removed from the holder

Siren Mode.label: Siren Mode
Siren Mode.description: Determines how the siren shall react on alarm

Remember Device Status After Power Failu.label: Remember Device Status After Power Failure
Remember Device Status After Power Failu.description: Define how the plug will react after the power supply is back on

Configure The State of Led.label: Configure The State of Led
Configure The State of Led.description: This parameter is used to configure the LED state when the smart switch is in energy mode/momentary indicate mode/night light mode

Siren Alarm Tone Length.label: Siren Alarm Tone Length
Siren Alarm Tone Length.description: The additional siren is creating a different acoustic signal differentiate from the smoke alarm. this sound is partly on and partly off. this parameter defines the total length of the sound versus silence within this interval. please make sure this value is always smaller (shorter time) than parameter 1 that defines the whole sequence

Value of Off-command.label: Value of Off-command
Value of Off-command.description: This value is sent as Basic Set to association group 3 when an smoke alarm is cleared

Temperature Scale.label: Temperature Scale
Temperature Scale.description: Sensor will report temperature in this scale

Led Indication Mode.label: Led Indication Mode
Led Indication Mode.description: 1. show switch state：when switch is on, LED is on. when switch is off, LED is off. the default setting is show switch state.  2. show night mode：when switch is on, LED is off. when switch is off, LED is on.  3. one flash mode：when the state of switch changes, LED will be on only one second, then LED keeps off

Switch Status Report Mode.label: Switch Status Report Mode
Switch Status Report Mode.description: Whenever the status of switches changes, it will send a binary switch report to the group1 node. the default setting is 1 (enable)

Enable/Disable The Function of Parameter.label: Enable/Disable The Function of Parameter 111
Enable/Disable The Function of Parameter.description: Enable/disable the function of parameter 111.  note: this parameter cannot disable the low battery checking of the sensor itself

Which Value of The Sensor Binary Report.label: Which Value of The Sensor Binary Report Or Basic Set Will Be Sent When The Door is Opened/Closed
Which Value of The Sensor Binary Report.description: To set which value of the sensor binary report or Basic Set will be sent when the door is opened/closed

High Priority Power Report.label: High Priority Power Report
High Priority Power Report.description: This parameter determines the minimum percentage change in active power that will result in sending power report to the main controller with the highest priority in the Z-Wave network. by default, the wall plug immediately sends the power report if the power load changes by 80%.  note in extreme cases, reports may be sent every second if rapid and significant power load changes occur. frequent reporting may overload the Z-Wave network so these parameter’s settings should reflect significant changes in power load only

Energy Reporting Threshold.label: Energy Reporting Threshold
Energy Reporting Threshold.description: This parameter specifies the minimum change in energy consumption (in relation to the previously reported), that will result in sending a new report

Measuring Energy Consumed By The Wall Pl.label: Measuring Energy Consumed By The Wall Plug Itself
Measuring Energy Consumed By The Wall Pl.description: This parameter determines whether energy metering should include the amount of energy consumed by the wall plug itself. results are being added to energy consumed by controlled device

Control of „on/Off (button)” Association.label: Control of „on/Off (button)” Association Group (2) Devices
Control of „on/Off (button)” Association.description: Controlling devices with the b-button. this parameter is inactive in “always on” mode (parameter 1). control as the wall plug: • switching the wall plug on – switch the devices on (parameter 24) • switching the wall plug off – switch the devices off (parameter 24) control opposite to the wall plug: • switching the wall plug on – switch the devices off • switching the wall plug off – switch the devices on

Switch On Value - „on/Off” Association G.label: Switch On Value - „on/Off” Association Groups
Switch On Value - „on/Off” Association G.description: The value of Basic Set command frame sent to the devices associated in „on/off” association groups (2, 3). „on/off (button)” association group - in accordance with parameter 20. „on/off (power)” association group - in accordance with parameter 23.  note setting parameter 24 to appropriate value will result in:  0 - turning off associated devices 1-99 - forcing level of associated devices 255 - setting associated devices to the last remembered state or turning them on

Active Alarms.label: Active Alarms
Active Alarms.description: Define Z-Wave network alarms to which the wall plug will respond

Led Ring Colour When Controlled Device i.label: Led Ring Colour When Controlled Device is On
Led Ring Colour When Controlled Device i.description: When set to 1 or 2, LED ring colour will change depending on active power and parameter 40. other colours are set permanently and do not depend on power consumption

Led Ring Illumination Colour At The Z-Wa.label: Led Ring Illumination Colour At The Z-Wave Network Alarm Detection

Manual On/Off Mode.description: The on/off function of s1、s2 and learn switch can be disabled or enabled by this parameter, default value is enable. but the learning operation won’t be affected. when manual on/off function is disabled, the rf command can only switch on but not off. this is useful function for keeping the device in switch on state

Siren Alarm Sequence Interval.label: Siren Alarm Sequence Interval
Siren Alarm Sequence Interval.description: The additional siren is creating a different acoustic signal differentiate from the smoke alarm. this sound is partly on and partly off. this parameter defines the total length of the interval in seconds

First Channel - Reaction to Switch For D.label: First Channel - Reaction to Switch For Delay/Auto On/Off Modes
First Channel - Reaction to Switch For D.description: This parameter determines how the device in timed mode reacts to pushing the switch connected to the s1 terminal. 0 - cancel mode and set target state 1 - no reaction to switch - mode runs until it ends 2 - reset timer - start counting from the beginning

Switch Type.label: Switch Type
Switch Type.description: This parameter as what type the device should treat the switch connected to the s1 and s2 terminals. 0 - momentary switch 1 - toggle switch (contact closed - on, contact opened - off) 2 - toggle switch (device changes status when switch changes status)

S1 Switch - Scenes Sent.label: S1 Switch - Scenes Sent
S1 Switch - Scenes Sent.description: This parameter determines which actions result in sending scene assigned to them.  1 - key pressed 1 time 2 - key pressed 2 time 4 - key pressed 3 time 8 - key hold down and key released   note parameter 28 values may be combined, e.g. 1+2=3 means that scenes for single and double click are sent

S1 Switch - Associations Sent to 2nd And.label: S1 Switch - Associations Sent to 2nd And 3rd Association Groups
S1 Switch - Associations Sent to 2nd And.description: This parameter determines which actions are ignored when sending commands to devices associated in 2nd and 3rd association group. all actions are active by default.  1 - ignore turning on with 1 click of the switch 2 - ignore turning off with 1 click of the switch 4 - ignore holding and releasing the switch* 8 - ignore double click of the switch**  note parameter 30 values may be combined, e.g. 1+2=3 means that associations for turning on and off are not sent. note *hold and release is inactive when parameter 20 is set to 1 or 2. **double click is inactive when parameter 20 is set to 1

Reaction to General Alarm.label: Reaction to General Alarm
Reaction to General Alarm.description: This parameter determines how the device will react to general alarm frame  0 - alarm frame is ignored 1 - turn on after receiving the alarm frame 2 - turn off after receiving the alarm frame 3 - flash after receiving the alarm frame

Reaction to Co/Co2/Smoke Alarm.label: Reaction to Co/Co2/Smoke Alarm
Reaction to Co/Co2/Smoke Alarm.description: This parameter determines how the device will react to co, co2 or smoke frame. 0 - alarm frame is ignored 1 - turn on after receiving the alarm frame 2 - turn off after receiving the alarm frame 3 - flash after receiving the alarm frame

First Channel - Power Reports.label: First Channel - Power Reports
First Channel - Power Reports.description: This parameter determines the minimum change in consumed power that will result in sending new power report to the main controller. 0 - reports are disabled 1-100 (1-100%) - change in power

First Channel - Energy Reports.label: First Channel - Energy Reports
First Channel - Energy Reports.description: This parameter determines the minimum change in consumed energy that will result in sending new energy report to the main controller. 0 - reports are disabled 1-32000 (1-32000wh) - change in energy

Periodic Energy Reports.label: Periodic Energy Reports
Periodic Energy Reports.description: This parameter determines in what time interval the periodic energy reports are sent to the main controller.  0 - periodic reports are disabled 1-32000 (1-32000s) - report interval

Restore State After Power Failure.label: Restore State After Power Failure
Restore State After Power Failure.description: This parameter determines if the device will return to state prior to the power failure after power is restored. 0 - the device does not save the state prior to the power failure and returns to „off” position 1 - the device restores its state prior to the power failure

Measuring Energy Consumed By The Device.label: Measuring Energy Consumed By The Device Itself
Measuring Energy Consumed By The Device.description: This parameter determines whether energy metering should include the amount of energy consumed by the device itself. results are being added to energy reports for first endpoint. 0 - function inactive 1 - function activate

Leddirect.label: Leddirect
Leddirect.description: Synchronization of load power and LED indicator. 0: power on, LED off 1: power on, LED on

Threshold of Change in Wattage.label: Threshold of Change in Wattage
Threshold of Change in Wattage.description: The value here represents minimum change in wattage (in terms of wattage) for sending a meter report (for wattage) to the associated device (group lifeline)

Delay On.label: Delay On
Delay On.description: Delay from activation request until load activation.  please note that possible values are referenced in hex format from 0x00 to 0xff (unsigned 1 byte values).  please refer to "Z-Wave command class specification, a-m" --> "multilevel switch set command" --> "duration table" specification to lean more about these values meaning

Behavior of LED in Repose.label: Behavior of LED in Repose
Behavior of LED in Repose.description: Configuration of main LED as identification at 20%

Reset Default.label: Reset Default
Reset Default.description: Device persorms a factoy default reset

Standy Power Setting Value.label: Standy Power Setting Value
Standy Power Setting Value.description: This parameter determines whether to use the standby power cutoff function and determines the reference value of standby power cut off.  if ther power consumption is less than the reference value, switch is turned off.   this parameter value's size is 4 bytes.  first 3 bytes is for setting standby power reference value.  last 1 byte is for standby power monitoring function enable or disable. - standby power setting value : 3 byte - standby power enable/disble : 1 byte) standby power value example :   if the value is set by 300(0x00012c), standby power is 3.00w  standby power function enable/disable example : if standby power is enable, value is 0x01.   and, total 4 bytes is 0x00012c01,   ( default parameter value : 0 – 0.00w, standbypower disable) (max standby reference power is 600w, 0x00ea60)

Enable / Disable Endpoints I3 Or Select.label: Enable / Disable Endpoints I3 Or Select Notification Type And Event
Enable / Disable Endpoints I3 Or Select.description: Enabling i3 means that endpoint (i3) will be present on ui. disabling it will result in hiding the endpoint according to the parameter set value. additionally, a notification type and event can be selected for the endpoint. available configuration parameters (data type is 1 byte dec): endpoint device type selection: - notification sensor (1 - 6): generic_type_sensor_notification, specific_type_notification_sensor • default value 0 • 1 - home security; motion detection, unknown loc. • 2 - co; carbon monoxide detected, unknown loc. • 3 - co2; carbon dioxide detected, unknown loc. • 4 - water alarm; water leak detected, unknown loc. • 5 - heat alarm; overheat detected, unknown loc. • 6 - smoke alarm; smoke detected, unknown loc. • 0 - endpoint, i3 disabled - sensor binary (9): generic_type_sensor_binary, specific_type_not_used • 9 - sensor binary  note1: after parameter change, first exclude module (without setting parameters to default value) then wait at least 30s and then re include the module! note 2: when the parameter is set to value 9 the notifications are send for home security

Unsecure / Secure Inclusion.label: Unsecure / Secure Inclusion

Interior Status LED Control.label: Interior Status LED Control
Interior Status LED Control.description: The configuration parameter 35 is a one byte field that will allow the user to get / set the value for the interior status LED control. the value of 0 means that the setting is disabled; whereas the value of 1 means that the setting is enabled. sending a set command with the default field set to 1 will cause the control to revert back to its factory default setting

Automatic Turning Off Output After Set T.description: Turns off the output after set time

Minimum Dimming Value.label: Minimum Dimming Value
Minimum Dimming Value.description: Note: the minimum level may not be higher than the maximum level! 1% min. dimming value is defined by Z-Wave multilevel device class. when the switch type is selected as bi-stable, it is not possible to dim the value between min and max. if switch_multilevel_set is set to the value “0”, the output is turned off. if switch_multilevel_set is set to the value “1”, the output is set to the minimum diming value

On_behaviour.label: On_behaviour
On_behaviour.description: Behaviour after basic on (and similar commands). if a transition (even with zero change) with a non-default duration is to be processed, the transition cannot be interrupted by any motion event in any case.  for values 1-209 - lamp is switched on and remains so until after a specified timeout once a new motion event (local or remote) is received. it then works normally via current motion evaluation

On_off_behavior.label: On_off_behavior
On_off_behavior.description: Behaviour after after a rapid sequence of basic on and basic off commands. the intention is to use a much longer timeout value than the time after a single on command which should then be followed by a short timeout value. the behaviour is almost the same as for parameter 10 (off_local_disable)   for values 1-209 - lamp is switched off and remains so until after a specified timeout once a new motion event (local or remote) is received

Motion_disable.label: Motion_disable
Motion_disable.description: Motion disable timeout after Basic Set to motion endpoint when the internal motion sensor is not used for evaluating the behaviour of the lamp and groups 2 and 3. events are, however, still transmitted to the lifeline, and the lamp can be controlled via remote motion sensors.  for values 1-209 - internal motion sensor is disabled for specified timeout after Basic Set 0x00 to motion endpoint

Brightnes Meas Interval.label: Brightnes Meas Interval
Brightnes Meas Interval.description: Brightness measuring interval [ minutes ] interval for ambient light measuring when lamp is on ( lamp switches off shortly and measures ). 0=function is off

Slave_mode.label: Slave_mode
Slave_mode.description: Can disable sensor controll  “stupid” mode (bit 2 = 1):  - has higher priority then slave mode.  - lamp is permanently on (usefull for simple power wall switch controlling).  slave mode ( bit 0 = 1 ): - only if included in Z-Wave network - usefull for controlling via third-party sensor - lamp is directly controlled via Z-Wave, internal sensors are not used for controlling it. central unit checking ( bit 1 = 1 ): ( usefull especialy for controlling via gateway ) when slave bit is 0: - lamp signalises fail of lifeline connection ( if this bit is zero fail of lifeline connection is not signalised ) when slave bit is 1: - lamp checks presence of Z-Wave device in lifeline group ( gateway ). if it is not present for 2 minutes ( testing repeatedly every 30 seconds ) device switches to normal mode in the same way as after the end of local disabled mode ( on_behaviour ) - the device checks every 1 minute for recovery of lifeline connection. - if no lifeline specified - it works in normal mode  be careful with this option, lamp stops using it’s own motion sensor in slave and stupid mode

Overheat Protection.label: Overheat Protection
Overheat Protection.description: Output load will be turned off automatically after 30 seconds and if the temperature of product inside exceeds 100 ℃

Working Mode.label: Working Mode
Working Mode.description: With this parameter is possible to change the module presentation on the user interface  note: after parameter change, first exclude module (without setting parameters to default value) then wait at least 30s and then re include the module!

Reset The Mote.description: Reset the mote to factory default

Off_behaviour.label: Off_behaviour
Off_behaviour.description: Behaviour after basic off ( and similar commands ). if a transition ( even with zero change ) with a non-default duration is to be processed, the transition cannot be interrupted by any motion event in any case.  for values 1-209 - lamp is switched off and remains so until after a specified timeout once a new motion event (local or remote) is received

Off_on_behaviour.label: Off_on_behaviour
Off_on_behaviour.description: Behaviour after after a rapid sequence of basic off and basic on commands. the intention is to use a much longer timeout value than the time after a single off command which should then be followed by a short timeout value. the behaviour is amost the same as for parameter 11  for values 1-209 - lamp is switched on and remains so until after a specified timeout once a new motion event (local or remote) is received. it then works normally via current motion evaluation

Global_light.label: Global_light
Global_light.description: Use external ambient light value when global_light mode is on – device overrides its own light sensor values and uses light report values from any Z-Wave light sensor instead – this has to be configured appropriately to send light automatically. if the last remote light level value is older than 30 minutes, the internal light value is used again until the next external value is received

Control of Devices Linked With Groups 2,.label: Control of Devices Linked With Groups 2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9
Control of Devices Linked With Groups 2,.description: Defines in which cases the control of the linked devices will be activated with a "click" of a configured button. in order to control devices linked to a group these devices have to belong to this group

Led Feedback.label: Led Feedback

Motion Sensor’s Sensitivity.label: Motion Sensor’s Sensitivity
Motion Sensor’s Sensitivity.description: The higher the value is set, the more sensitive the PIR sensor are

On_time_over.label: On_time_over
On_time_over.description: Time limit to stop waiting for motion after timeout of on_behaviour or off_on_behaviour ( 0-209 ) to prevent staying on forever when is no motion

Value of Basic On Command Sent to 2nd As.label: Value of Basic On Command Sent to 2nd Association Group
Value of Basic On Command Sent to 2nd As.description: This parameter defines the value of basic on command sent to devices in 2nd association group after the co alarm activation. 1-99 - forcing level of associated devices  255 - setting associated devices to the last remembered state or turning them on

Power Report Frequency.label: Power Report Frequency

Overload Protection.label: Overload Protection
Overload Protection.description: Smart switch keep detecting the load power, once the ac current exceeds 16.5a for more than 5s, smart switch's relay will turn off

Dimmer Level Report Mode.label: Dimmer Level Report Mode
Dimmer Level Report Mode.description: Whenever dimmer on/off state changes, it will send multilevel_switch_report to the nodes of group1. the default setting is enable the function

External Switch Type.label: External Switch Type
External Switch Type.description: 1. one switch mode：only s1 can dim up the light bulb to brightest level, then dim down to darkest level, and so on…  2. two switch mode：s1 and s2 can dim up the light bulb to brightest level, then dim down to darkest level, and so on…  3. up/down switch mode：s1 can only dim up the light bulb to brightest level, and s2 can only dim down to off

Configure The RGB Value.description: Configure the RGB value when it is in night light mode

Temperature Sensor Reporting.label: Temperature Sensor Reporting
Temperature Sensor Reporting.description: If digital temperature sensor is connected, module reports measured temperature on temperature change defined by this parameter.   available configuration parameters (data type is 1 byte dec): • default value 5 = 0,5°c  • 0 - reporting disabled • 1-127 = 0,1°c - 12,7°c, step is 0,1°c

Power Reporting in Watts By Time Interva.label: Power Reporting in Watts By Time Interval For Q1 Or Q2
Power Reporting in Watts By Time Interva.description: Set value means time interval (0 – 32767) in seconds, when power report is send

Slats Tilting Full Turn Time.label: Slats Tilting Full Turn Time
Slats Tilting Full Turn Time.description: This parameter defines the time necessary for slats to make full turn (180 degrees)

Motor Moving Up/Down Time.label: Motor Moving Up/Down Time
Motor Moving Up/Down Time.description: This parameter defines shutter motor moving time of complete opening or complete closing.   note: important is that the reference position to manually set moving time is always shutter lower position! set parameter 74 to 0 and move the shutter (using up/down push buttons or main controller ui) to the lowest desired position. on this shutter position, set parameter 74 to time for complete opening or complete closing. at this point shutter can be moved up (open) for set time, but can't be moved down because this position is already set as lower shutter position. to change shutter lower position below already set (manual recalibration), parameter 74 must be set to 0 and repeat the procedure described above. in case shutter has limit switches, but anyhow you would like to limit opening/closing position by time, you can still do it. in case you put time that is longer that opening/closing real time limited by limit switches, shutter will stop at limit switch, but the module relay will switch off after define time, not by shutter limit switch. take in consideration that in this condition, the positioning with slider through ui will not show correct shutter position

– Power Consumption Max Delay Time.label: – Power Consumption Max Delay Time
– Power Consumption Max Delay Time.description: This parameter defines the max time before motor power consumption is read after one of the relays is switched on. if there is no power consumption during this max time (motor not connected, damaged or requires higher time to start, motor in end position) the relay will switch off. time is defined by entering it manually

To Set What Unsolicited Report Would Be.label: To Set What Unsolicited Report Would Be Sent to The Lifeline Group
To Set What Unsolicited Report Would Be.description: To set what unsolicited report would be sent to the lifeline group

When The Parameter 0x87 is Set to 2 Or 3.label: When The Parameter 0x87 is Set to 2 Or 3, It Can Get The Sensor Probes’ Status Through This Configuration Value
When The Parameter 0x87 is Set to 2 Or 3.description: When the parameter 0x87 is set to 2 or 3, it can get the sensor probes’ status through this configuration value.  note: this parameter is a get- only parameter

Power Reporting in Watts On Power Change.label: Power Reporting in Watts On Power Change For Q1 Or Q2

Time Delay For Next Motor Movement.label: Time Delay For Next Motor Movement

Motor Operation Detection.label: Motor Operation Detection

Measured Temperature Report.label: Measured Temperature Report

Window Open Detection.label: Window Open Detection

Enable/Disable Basic Set Command.label: Enable/Disable Basic Set Command
Enable/Disable Basic Set Command.description: Motion sensor can send Basic Set command to nodes associated with group 2 when motion is triggered

Motion Alarm Cancellation Delay.label: Motion Alarm Cancellation Delay
Motion Alarm Cancellation Delay.description: Motion alarm will be cancelled in the main controller after 3 seconds, the alarm cancellation can be delay by this parameter. any motion detected during the cancellation delay time countdown will result in the countdown being restarted

Enable/Disable The LED Blinking When The.label: Enable/Disable The LED Blinking When The PIR is Triggered
Enable/Disable The LED Blinking When The.description: Enable/disable the LED blinking when the PIR is triggered

Power Reporting.label: Power Reporting
Power Reporting.description: This parameter determines the minimum percentage change in active power consumption (in relation to the previously reported) that will result in sending new power report

Periodic Energy Reporting.label: Periodic Energy Reporting
Periodic Energy Reporting.description: This parameter defines time period between independent reports sent when changes in power load have not been recorded or if changes are insignificant. by default reports are sent every hour
