Turn Load 1 (q⬆) On Automatically With T.label: Turn Load 1 (q⬆) On Automatically With Timer
Turn Load 1 (q⬆) On Automatically With T.description: If load (q⬆) is off, you can schedule it to turn on automatically after a period of time defined in this parameter. the timer is reset to zero each time the device receives an off command, either remotely (from the gateway (hub) or associated device) or locally from the switch

Set Timer Units to Seconds Or Millisecon.label: Set Timer Units to Seconds Or Milliseconds
Set Timer Units to Seconds Or Millisecon.description: Choose if you want to set the timer in seconds or milliseconds in parameters 11 and 12.  please note that the value for this parameter applies to settings for q⬆ load in all of the above parameters (timer on / timer off)

Restore On/Off Status For Q⬆ Load After.label: Restore On/Off Status For Q⬆ Load After Power Failure
Restore On/Off Status For Q⬆ Load After.description: This parameter determines if on/off status is saved and restored for the load q⬆ after power failure

Watt Power Consumption Reporting Time Th.label: Watt Power Consumption Reporting Time Threshold For Q⬆ Load
Watt Power Consumption Reporting Time Th.description: Set value refers to the time interval with which power consumption in watts is reported (0 – 32535 seconds). if 300 is entered (by default), energy consumption reports will be sent to the gateway (hub) every 300 seconds (or 5 minutes)

Lcd Timeout.label: Lcd Timeout
Lcd Timeout.description: Configures the timeout of the lcd

Valve Percentage Report.label: Valve Percentage Report
Valve Percentage Report.description: Reports the valve percentage on change

To Configure Which Sensor Report Will Be.label: To Configure Which Sensor Report Will Be Sent When The Door is Opened/Closed
To Configure Which Sensor Report Will Be.description: To configure which sensor report will be sent when the door is opened/closed

Lock Input.label: Lock Input
Lock Input.description: Locks the local control of the sunblind.  this configuration does not modifies the control via Z-Wave

Lock Hold Press.label: Lock Hold Press
Lock Hold Press.description: Locks the major part of hold press effects in order to avoid undesired callibrations, Z-Wave changes or restores default.  0xff hold press from 2sec to 20 sec does not performs a node info hold press of 10 to 15 does not performs a automatic callibration hold press of 15 to 30 does not changes the sunblind or awing reports hold press of 30sec restores configuration except lock hold press, and sends a node info in order to add or remove from Z-Wave network

Association Led.label: Association Led
Association Led.description: Activates the central led. configuration used by masters io in order to identify the devices associated to their group2 during manual association process

Send Central Scene.label: Send Central Scene
Send Central Scene.description: Disables the sending of central scene notifications to avoid perform 2 actions at same time (central scene action and group 2 action)

Press Action.label: Press Action
Press Action.description: Defines the function performed by the device when keypad is pressed

Activation Time.label: Activation Time
Activation Time.description: Sets the time when the load will be turned off after it is activated.  this configuration must be set in hexadecimal values. 0x00 disables the delay. 0x01 to 0x7f time is set in seconds from 1 to 127 0x80 to 0xef time is set in minutes from 1 to 127

Postreset State.label: Postreset State
Postreset State.description: Sets the device state after a reset

Identify.label: Identify
Identify.description: Central LED performs a fast blink

Beacon.label: Beacon
Beacon.description: Sets the beacon intensity, turning on all device leds al percentage set in this configuration

Get The Out-of-limit State of The Sensor.label: Get The Out-of-limit State of The Sensors
Get The Out-of-limit State of The Sensor.description: Get the out-of-limit state of the sensors

Light Zone Control Mode.label: Light Zone Control Mode
Light Zone Control Mode.description: Controls if the light zones should operate in switch or dimmer mode (only used in button modes 0, 1 and 2): 0 – all light zones in dimmer mode (default) 1 – all light zones in switch mode (default with relay back unit)  to control light zones mode individually, add any of the following values to enable switch mode individually (dimmer is default): 2 – light zone 1 switch mode 4 – light zone 2 switch mode 8 – light zone 3 switch mode 16 – light zone 4 switch mode example: a value of 10 (8 + 2) enables switch mode in light zone 1 and 3

Room Sensor Temperature Offset.label: Room Sensor Temperature Offset
Room Sensor Temperature Offset.description: Temperature offset in 1/10th of a degree celcius

Thermostat On∕off Interval Override Thre.label: Thermostat On∕off Interval Override Threshold
Thermostat On∕off Interval Override Thre.description: Temperature threshold in 1/10th of a degree celcius

Setting The Parameters 101~104 to The De.label: Setting The Parameters 101~104 to The Default Value
Setting The Parameters 101~104 to The De.description: Setting the parameters 101~104 to the default value

Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (k.label: Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (kwh)
Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (k.description: The interval of sending meter report (kwh) to association device (group lifeline)

Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (c.label: Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (current)
Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (c.description: The interval time of sending meter report (current) to associated device (group lifeline)

The Value Here Represents Minimum Change.label: The Value Here Represents Minimum Change in Wattage Percent (in Terms of Percentage) For a Meter Report (watt) to Be Sent
The Value Here Represents Minimum Change.description: When the change value of the load power exceeds the setting value, smart plug will send meter report to associated device (group lifeline)

Colors_table [14].label: Colors_table [14]
Colors_table [14].description: Definition of the color value (rgb) - color table row 14 command class color switch

Color Index Configuration When The LED S.label: Color Index Configuration When The LED Strip is in Multi Color Mode
Color Index Configuration When The LED S.description: Color index configuration when the LED strip is in multi color mode

Enable/Disable to Send The Basic Report.label: Enable/Disable to Send The Basic Report
Enable/Disable to Send The Basic Report.description: Enable/disable to send the basic report to the lifeline when the load state changed (when value set as 1, re-power on the dimmer, it will send basic report automatically）

Enable/Disable to Lock All Configuration.label: Enable/Disable to Lock All Configuration Parameters
Enable/Disable to Lock All Configuration.description: Enable/disable to lock all configuration parameters

Enable/ Disable to Blink The Orange LED.label: Enable/ Disable to Blink The Orange LED When Wallmote Sends Out Wake Up Notification
Enable/ Disable to Blink The Orange LED.description: Enable/ disable to blink the orange LED when wallmote sends out wake up notification

Enable/ Disable to Light On The Orange L.label: Enable/ Disable to Light On The Orange LED When Wallmote is in Usb Charging
Enable/ Disable to Light On The Orange L.description: Enable/ disable to light on the orange LED when wallmote is in usb charging

In-wall Switch Type For Load 1 (q⬆) to C.label: In-wall Switch Type For Load 1 (q⬆) to Control I1
In-wall Switch Type For Load 1 (q⬆) to C.description: With this parameter, you can select between push-button (momentary) and on/off toggle switch types

Watt Power Consumption Reporting Thresho.label: Watt Power Consumption Reporting Threshold For Q⬆ Load
Watt Power Consumption Reporting Thresho.description: Choose by how much power consumption needs to increase or decrease to be reported. values correspond to percentages so if 10 is set (by default), the device will report any power consumption changes of 10% or more compared to the last reading.   note: power consumption needs to increase or decrease by at least 1 watt to be reported, regardless of percentage set in this parameter

Enable/Disable The Buzzer Alarm When Bat.label: Enable/Disable The Buzzer Alarm When Battery is Running Low
Enable/Disable The Buzzer Alarm When Bat.description: When the value is 0,the product will not allow the buzzer alarm when battery is running low;when the value is 1,the product will allow the buzzer alarm when battery is running low

Remember Device Status Before The Power.label: Remember Device Status Before The Power Failure
Remember Device Status Before The Power.description: This parameter determines how the wall plug will react in the event of power supply failure (e.g. power outage or taking out from the electrical outlet).  after the power supply is back on, the wall plug can be restored to previous state or remain switched off

Response to Alarm Frames.label: Response to Alarm Frames
Response to Alarm Frames.description: This parameter defines how the wall plug will respond to alarms (device’s status change). in case of values 1 or 2 the wall plug is operating normally and LED frame signals an alarm through time defined in parameter 32 or until the alarm is canceled. in case of values 5 to 50 the wall plug does not report status change, power changes, ignores Basic Set command frames. after time defined in parameter 32 or after the alarm cancellation, connected device is set to the previous state

Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (v.label: Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (voltage)
Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (v.description: The interval of sending meter report (voltage) to association device (group lifeline)

Led Load Indicator Mode Selection.label: Led Load Indicator Mode Selection
Led Load Indicator Mode Selection.description: Configure LED display mode to prevent light pollution at night

Led Color For Light Sensor Report.label: Led Color For Light Sensor Report
Led Color For Light Sensor Report.description: ‘0’ – disable. ‘1’ – red. ‘2’ –green. ‘3’ – blue. ‘4’ – yellow. ‘5’ – pink. ‘6’ – cyan. ‘7’ – purple. ‘8’ – orange

Led Color For Wakeup Notification Report.label: Led Color For Wakeup Notification Report
Led Color For Wakeup Notification Report.description: ‘0’ – disable. ‘1’ – red. ‘2’ –green. ‘3’ – blue. ‘4’ – yellow. ‘5’ – pink. ‘6’ – cyan. ‘7’ – purple. ‘8’ – orange

Basic Set Value Settings For Group 2.label: Basic Set Value Settings For Group 2
Basic Set Value Settings For Group 2.description: ‘0’ – send basic_set = 0xff to devices associated in group 2 when motion event is triggered, send basic_set = 0x00 to devices associated in group 2 when motion event is cleared. ‘1’– send basic_set = 0x00 to devices associated in group 2 when motion event is triggered, send basic_set = 0xff to devices associated in group 2 when motion event is cleared. ‘2’ – send basic_set = 0xff to devices associated in group 2 when motion event is triggered. ‘3’ – send basic_set = 0x00 to devices associated in group 2 when motion event is triggered. ‘4’ – send basic_set = 0x00 to devices associated in group 2 when motion event is cleared. ‘5’ – send basic_set = 0xff to devices associated in group 2 when motion event is cleared

Switch On Value - „on/Off (button)” Asso.label: Switch On Value - „on/Off (button)” Association Group (2)
Switch On Value - „on/Off (button)” Asso.description: The value of Basic Set command frame sent to the devices associated in 2nd group „on/off (button)” when turning the device on using the button

Led Frame Color At The Z-Wave Network Al.label: Led Frame Color At The Z-Wave Network Alarm Detection
Led Frame Color At The Z-Wave Network Al.description: This parameter defines the illumination color in case of Z-Wave alarm

The Interval Time of Sending The Humidit.label: The Interval Time of Sending The Humidity Reporting
The Interval Time of Sending The Humidit.description: The interval time of sending the humidity reporting. if setting to 0 then the humidity reporting is disabled  1. valid values: 0x00-0x28de80 2. the minimum interval time is 1 minutes. for example, if the value is set to be more than 1 and less than 60, the interval time is 1 minutes, if the value is set to be more than 60 and less than 120, the interval time is 2 minutes

The Interval Time of Sending The Battery.label: The Interval Time of Sending The Battery Level Reporting
The Interval Time of Sending The Battery.description: The interval time of sending the battery level reporting. if setting to 0 then the battery level reporting is disabled  1. valid values: 0x00-0x28de80 2. the minimum interval time is 1 minutes. for example, if the value is set to be more than 1 and less than 60, the interval time is 1 minutes, if the value is set to be more than 60 and less than 120, the interval time is 2 minutes

Configuration Luminance Change Threshold.label: Configuration Luminance Change Threshold
Configuration Luminance Change Threshold.description: Configuration luminance change threshold. valid values: 1-65528(unit lx)

Pir Triggers The Correspondence Between.label: Pir Triggers The Correspondence Between The Value of The Basic Set And The PIR State
Pir Triggers The Correspondence Between.description: Pir triggers the correspondence between the value of the Basic Set and the PIR state, when value is 0x00 PIR triggers send the Basic Set command 0xff PIR alarm release send the Basic Set command 0x00, otherwise PIR triggers send the Basic Set command 0x00 PIR alarm release send the Basic Set command 0xff

Saving Load State Before Power Failure.label: Saving Load State Before Power Failure
Saving Load State Before Power Failure.description: Saving load state before power failure

Setting Minimum Brightness Value.label: Setting Minimum Brightness Value
Setting Minimum Brightness Value.description: The bigger the value is, the higher the load’s minimum brightness is

Enable/Disable External Switch to Be Add.label: Enable/Disable External Switch to Be Added to And Removed From a Network
Enable/Disable External Switch to Be Add.description: Enable/disable external switch to be added to and removed from a network (when enables this function, triple press the external switch within 1.5 seconds to be added to or removed from a network)

The Interval Time of Sending The Tempera.label: The Interval Time of Sending The Temperature Reporting
The Interval Time of Sending The Tempera.description: The interval time of sending the temperature reporting. if setting to 0 then the temperature reporting is disabled  1. valid values: 0x00-0x28de80 2. the minimum interval time is 1 minutes. for example, if the value is set to be more than 1 and less than 60, the interval time is 1 minutes, if the value is set to be more than 60 and less than 120, the interval time is 2 minutes

Deadbolt Installed.label: Deadbolt Installed
Deadbolt Installed.description: 0x00 = no deadbolt , 0xff = yes deadbolt read only parameter. some locks contain optional deadbolt hardware. this parameter is used to determine if one is installed

Privacy Mode With Deadbolt.label: Privacy Mode With Deadbolt
Privacy Mode With Deadbolt.description: 0x00 = off, 0xff = on default is 0x00 or off if enabled then extending the deadbolt will put the lock into privacy mode

Operating Modes.label: Operating Modes
Operating Modes.description: This parameter defines selection between two available operating modes.   note1: after parameter change, first exclude module (without setting parameters to default value) then wait at least 30s and then re include the module!

Eco Mode On/Off.label: Eco Mode On/Off
Eco Mode On/Off.description: 0x00 = off, 0xff = on default is 0x00 or off if supported switches lock to lower power mode of operation with reduced sound and LED brightness

Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (w.label: Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (watt)
Setting Time For Sending Meter Report (w.description: The interval time of sending meter report (watt) to associated device (group lifeline)

Notification When Load Status Change.label: Notification When Load Status Change
Notification When Load Status Change.description: Smart plug can send notifications to associated device (group lifeline) when the status of smart plug’s load is changed

Threshold of Power Report.label: Threshold of Power Report
Threshold of Power Report.description: Power threshold to be interpreted, when the change value of load power exceeds the setting threshold, the smart plug will send meter report to association device (group lifeline)

Get Electrical High Preload Transition C.label: Get Electrical High Preload Transition Count
Get Electrical High Preload Transition C.description: Electronic state change count with high preload

Beeper.label: Beeper
Beeper.description: This configuration setting controls the keypad beeper of the deadbolt allowing the keypad beeper to be turned on or off

Lock And Leave Mode.label: Lock And Leave Mode
Lock And Leave Mode.description: This configuration setting controls the use of the "schlage" button on the keypad for single button push for throwing the deadbolt

Blue LED Brightness Level While The Swit.label: Blue LED Brightness Level While The Switch is On
Blue LED Brightness Level While The Swit.description: Adjusts brightness of the blue indicator LED 0 = off 4 = maximum brightness

Blue LED Brightness Level While The Swit.label: Blue LED Brightness Level While The Switch is Off
Blue LED Brightness Level While The Swit.description: Adjust brightness of the blue indicator LED with switch is off 0 = off 4 = maximum brightness

Meter Report Interval.label: Meter Report Interval
Meter Report Interval.description: Time interval between consecutive meter reports. meter reports can be also sent as a result of polling. 0 reporting of metering values is disabled 30 - 32767 30 seconds – 32767 seconds. default is 60 seconds

Reset The Nano Shutter.label: Reset The Nano Shutter
Reset The Nano Shutter.description: Reset the nano shutter to factory default

Set The Operation Mode of External Switc.label: Set The Operation Mode of External Switch
Set The Operation Mode of External Switc.description: Set the operation mode of external switch.  note: for the description of operation mode 1 or 2, please refer to the user manual

Reverse Open/Close Detection.label: Reverse Open/Close Detection
Reverse Open/Close Detection.description: This parameter allows you to reverse the detection values of the device

Set Ir Code Number From Built-in Code Li.label: Set Ir Code Number From Built-in Code Library

Auto Lock.label: Auto Lock
Auto Lock.description: This configuration setting controls the lock feature that automatically throws the deadbolt 30 seconds after a valid user code has been entered at the keypad

Sound Playback.label: Sound Playback
Sound Playback.description: 0: stop to play sound; n: play the n file(n: 1~99)

On Off Status After Power Failure.label: On Off Status After Power Failure
On Off Status After Power Failure.description: Set the on off status for the switch after power failure

To Configure Which Report Will Be Sent W.label: To Configure Which Report Will Be Sent When Pressing The Buttons
To Configure Which Report Will Be Sent W.description: To set which notification would be sent to the associated devices (group 1) when pressing the buttons

Enable/ Disable The LED Indication When.label: Enable/ Disable The LED Indication When Pressing The Control Buttons
Enable/ Disable The LED Indication When.description: Enable/ disable the LED indication when pressing the control buttons

Enable/ Disable Auto Turn-off Timer For.label: Enable/ Disable Auto Turn-off Timer For Ch2
Enable/ Disable Auto Turn-off Timer For.description: Use this parameter to enable or disable the auto turn-off timer for ch2 outlet

Enable/ Disable Auto Turn-off Timer For.label: Enable/ Disable Auto Turn-off Timer For Ch1
Enable/ Disable Auto Turn-off Timer For.description: Use this parameter to enable or disable the auto turn-off timer for ch1 outlet. if this feature is enabled, the device connected to ch1 outlet will automatically turn off after a fixed period of time from being turned on (set in parameter 7)

Force Calibration.label: Force Calibration
Force Calibration.description: By setting this parameter to 2 the device enters the calibration mode. the parameter relevant only if the device is set to work in positioning mode (parameter 151 set to 1, 2 or 4)

Set Slats Back to Previous Position.label: Set Slats Back to Previous Position
Set Slats Back to Previous Position.description: For venetian blinds (parameter 151 set to 2) the parameter determines slats positioning in various situations. the parameter is irrelevant for other modes.  note: if parameter 20 is set to 1 (toggle switch), change value of parameter 153 to 0 for slats to work properly

Inputs Orientation.label: Inputs Orientation
Inputs Orientation.description: This parameter allows reversing the operation of switches connected to s1 and s2 without changing the wiring

Alarm Configuration - 1st Slot.label: Alarm Configuration - 1st Slot
Alarm Configuration - 1st Slot.description: This parameter determines to which alarm frames and how the device should react. the parameters consist of 4 bytes, three most significant bytes are set according to the official Z-Wave protocol specification.  note: alarm with lower number has the higher priority, thus first alarm will override other alarms with the same type.  note: setting notification value to 0xff will result in launching the action twice: when alarm occurs and is cancelled

Power Reports - Periodic.label: Power Reports - Periodic
Power Reports - Periodic.description: This parameter determines in what time intervals the periodic power reports are sent to the main controller. periodic reports do not depend on power change (parameter 61)

Energy Reports - Periodic.label: Energy Reports - Periodic
Energy Reports - Periodic.description: This parameter determines in what time intervals the periodic energy reports are sent to the main controller. periodic reports do not depend on energy change (parameter 65)

Alternate Exclusion.label: Alternate Exclusion
Alternate Exclusion.description: This parameter allows you to enable the alternate exclusion method that is available for this device

Led Indicator Mode.label: Led Indicator Mode
Led Indicator Mode.description: Choose if you want the LED indicators next to each outlet to come on when power is on or off, or if you want to disable them

Periodic Power Reporting.label: Periodic Power Reporting
Periodic Power Reporting.description: This parameter defines time period between independent reports sent when changes in power load have not been recorded or if changes are insignificant. by default reports are sent every hour

Outputs Orientation.label: Outputs Orientation
Outputs Orientation.description: This parameter allows reversing operation of out1 and out2 inputs without changing the wiring. use in case of incorrect wiri ng

Input 2 - Sent Scenes.label: Input 2 - Sent Scenes
Input 2 - Sent Scenes.description: This parameter defines which actions result in sending scene id and attribute assigned to them (see 9: activating scenes). parameter is relevant only if parameter 20 is set to 2 or 3

Factory Reset Or Initialization (write O.label: Factory Reset Or Initialization (write Only)
Factory Reset Or Initialization (write O.description: Parameter 51/52/53/54 will not restore the configuration settings to the default when factory reset or initialization is performed

Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes.label: Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes in Group 3
Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes in Group 5
Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes in Group 7
Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes in Group 9

Tigger Pairing Button Mode (write Only).label: Tigger Pairing Button Mode (write Only)
Tigger Pairing Button Mode (write Only).description: (1) can not trigger pairing multiple buttons at one time. (2) pairing time is up to 10 seconds. in this time period, user must manually click ring button 3 times quickly. otherwise it cannot be paired successfully. (3) each successful pairing will overwrite the previous paired button which has the same button number

Report Which Buttons Had Been Paired (re.label: Report Which Buttons Had Been Paired (read Only)
Report Which Buttons Had Been Paired (re.description: Once unpairing or pairing button mode finishes, node will automatically send this configuration report via lifeline to inform which buttons had been paired. this parameter does not restore to the default value when chime is removed from the network or reset the factory settings

Get The Information of #2 Button (read O.label: Get The Information of #2 Button (read Only)
Get The Information of #2 Button (read O.description: This parameter does not restore to the default value when chime is removed from the network or reset the factory settings

Led Frame – Colour When On.label: Led Frame – Colour When On
Led Frame – Colour When On.description: This parameter defines the LED colour when the device is on. when set to 8 or 9, LED frame colour will change depending on he measured power and parameter 10. other colours are set permanently and do not depend on power consumption

Led Frame – Brightness.label: Led Frame – Brightness
Led Frame – Brightness.description: This parameter allows to choose mode of 1st input (in1). change it depending on connected device

Alarm Configuration - 2nd Slot.label: Alarm Configuration - 2nd Slot
Alarm Configuration - 2nd Slot.description: This parameter determines to which alarm frames and how the device should react. the parameters consist of 4 bytes, three most significant bytes are set according to the official Z-Wave protocol specification

Alarm Configuration - 4th Slot.label: Alarm Configuration - 4th Slot
Alarm Configuration - 4th Slot.description: This parameter determines to which alarm frames and how the device should react. the parameters consist of 4 bytes, three most significant bytes are set according to the official Z-Wave protocol specification

Alarm Configuration – Duration.label: Alarm Configuration – Duration
Alarm Configuration – Duration.description: This parameter defines duration of alarm sequence. when time set in this parameter elapses, alarm is cancelled, LED frame and relay restore normal operation, but do not recover state from before the alarm

Power Reports – Include Self-consumption.label: Power Reports – Include Self-consumption
Power Reports – Include Self-consumption.description: This parameter determines whether the power measurements should include power consumed by the device itself

Energy Reports – On Change.label: Energy Reports – On Change
Energy Reports – On Change.description: This parameter defines minimal change (from the last reported) in measured energy that results in sending new report

Alarm Configuration - 3rd Slot.label: Alarm Configuration - 3rd Slot
Alarm Configuration - 3rd Slot.description: This parameter determines to which alarm frames and how the device should react. the parameters consist of 4 bytes, three most significant bytes are set according to the official Z-Wave protocol specification

First Button – Scenes Sent.label: First Button – Scenes Sent
First Button – Scenes Sent.description: This parameter determines which actions result in sending scene ids assigned to them. values can be combined (e.g. 1+2=3 means that scenes for single and double click are sent). enabling scenes for triple click disables entering the device in learn mode by triple clicking

Power Reports – On Change.label: Power Reports – On Change
Power Reports – On Change.description: This parameter defines minimal change (from the last reported) in measured power that results in sending new report. for loads under 50w the parameter is irrelevant, report are sent every 5w change

Minimum Temperature Change to Report.label: Minimum Temperature Change to Report
Minimum Temperature Change to Report.description: This value defines the minimum change of temperature to cause an unsolicited report of humidity to the central controller using lifeline. if the value is set to 0, there will be no reports sent to the controller, when the temperature changes. however, periodic reports, managed by configuration parameter 4, may still be active

Humidity Lower Watermark Value.label: Humidity Lower Watermark Value
Humidity Lower Watermark Value.description: This parameter defines a relative humidity. if the measured temperature drops below this relative humidity a basic command is sent into association group 5

Remember Device State.label: Remember Device State
Remember Device State.description: This parameter determines how the device will react in the event of power supply failure (e.g. power outage). the parameter is not relevant for outputs set to pulse mode (parameter 150/151 set to 2)

Buttons Orientation.label: Buttons Orientation
Buttons Orientation.description: This parameter allows reversing the operation of the buttons

Alarm Configuration - 5th Slot.label: Alarm Configuration - 5th Slot
Alarm Configuration - 5th Slot.description: This parameter determines to which alarm frames and how the device should react. the parameters consist of 4 bytes, three most significant bytes are set according to the official Z-Wave protocol specification

Auto-calibration After Power On.label: Auto-calibration After Power On
Auto-calibration After Power On.description: This parameter determines the trigger of auto-calibration procedure, e.g. power on, load error, etc

Brightness Level Correction For Flickeri.label: Brightness Level Correction For Flickering Loads
Brightness Level Correction For Flickeri.description: Correction reduces spontaneous flickering of some capacitive loads (e.g. dimmable leds) at certain brightness levels in 2-wire installation. in countries using ripple-control, correction may cause changes in brightness. in this case it is necessary to disable correction or adjust the time of correction for flickering loads

Approximated Power At The Maximum Bright.label: Approximated Power At The Maximum Brightness Level
Approximated Power At The Maximum Bright.description: (0-500w, 1w step) – power consumed by the load at the maximum brightness level

Lock Long Press.label: Lock Long Press
Lock Long Press.description: Locks or unlocks the long press on the key

When The Motion Sensor is Triggered, If.label: When The Motion Sensor is Triggered, If This Parameter is 0x01 Then It Will Send Basic Set Command to Group 1
When The Motion Sensor is Triggered, If.description: When the motion sensor is triggered, if this parameter is 0x01 then it will send Basic Set command to group 1

Calibration Required.label: Calibration Required
Calibration Required.description: Reports if calibration is required or not (read only)

Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes.label: Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes in Group 2
Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes in Group 6

Tigger Unpairing Button Mode (write Only.label: Tigger Unpairing Button Mode (write Only)
Tigger Unpairing Button Mode (write Only.description: (1) can trigger unpairing multiple buttons at one time. (2) user does not need to do anything to button. (3) indicator light will quickly flash white light 3 times when unpairing button mode finishes

Get The Information of #3 Button (read O.label: Get The Information of #3 Button (read Only)
Get The Information of #3 Button (read O.description: This parameter does not restore to the default value when chime is removed from the network or reset the factory settings

Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes.label: Configure How to Send Basic Set to Nodes in Group 4

Report Which Pairing Button Mode is Trig.label: Report Which Pairing Button Mode is Triggered (read Only)
Report Which Pairing Button Mode is Trig.description: Once pairing button mode is triggered, node will automatically send this configuration report via lifeline to inform which button is waiting for being paired

Enable Or Disable The Ability That Click.label: Enable Or Disable The Ability That Click The Action Button to Stop a Playing Tone

Get The Information of #1 Button (read O.label: Get The Information of #1 Button (read Only)
Get The Information of #1 Button (read O.description: This parameter does not restore to the default value when chime is removed from the network or reset the factory settings

Led Indication Configuration.label: Led Indication Configuration
Led Indication Configuration.description: Adjust the LED status to default, invert, always off or always on

Dim Up/Down Rate.label: Dim Up/Down Rate
Dim Up/Down Rate.description: Adjust the speed at which the ramps to a specific value other than 0 and ff

Wiring Type.label: Wiring Type
Wiring Type.description: Wiring type  note: this parameter is read only

Enable/Disable Over Current Protection.label: Enable/Disable Over Current Protection
Enable/Disable Over Current Protection.description: Enable/disable over current protection 0: disable 1: enable, when over current detected, there are two methods to cancel alarm: 1. short press either switch button s1 or s2, the alarm will last at least 1 minute and then be cancelled. 2. re-power on the curtain motor controller

Tilt Sensor Functionality.label: Tilt Sensor Functionality
Tilt Sensor Functionality.description: This parameter enables/disables the tilt function

Visual LED Indications.label: Visual LED Indications
Visual LED Indications.description: This parameter defines when the red LED will indicate events. disabling all indications may extend battery life

Command Sent to Devices of Association G.label: Command Sent to Devices of Association Group 2
Command Sent to Devices of Association G.description: This parameter defines which commands is sent to 2nd association group

Basic Command Value Sent to 2nd Associat.label: Basic Command Value Sent to 2nd Association Group On ‘off‘ Event
Basic Command Value Sent to 2nd Associat.description: This is the basic command value sent in case of ‘off‘ event

Default Brightness Level.label: Default Brightness Level
Default Brightness Level.description: Set the default brightness level that the dimmer will turn on when being controlled manually

Turn Load 1 On Automatically With Timer.label: Turn Load 1 On Automatically With Timer
Turn Load 1 On Automatically With Timer.description: If load is off, you can schedule it to turn on automatically after a period of time defined in this parameter. the timer is reset to zero each time the device receives an off or on command, either remotely (from the gateway (hub) or associated device) or locally from the switch

Overload Safety Switch.label: Overload Safety Switch
Overload Safety Switch.description: The function allows for turning off the controlled device in case of exceeding the defined power for more than 5s. controlled device can be turned back on by input i1 or sending a control frame. ⓘ note: this functionality is not an overload safety protection, please check the technical specifications chapter for more details. in case of overload the following message will be send towards the controller: • command_class_notification_v5 • the alarm v1 type field set to 0x00 • notification type 0x08 and 0x08 (overload detected)

Operating Pushbutton(s) For Dimmer.label: Operating Pushbutton(s) For Dimmer
Operating Pushbutton(s) For Dimmer.description: This parameter specifies which pushbutton(s) that shall be used to control the built-in dimmer. the parameter is a bitmask, so each of the values can be added together in order to have several pushbuttons to operate the dimmer

Associations Groups, Transmission When I.label: Associations Groups, Transmission When Included Secure
Associations Groups, Transmission When I.description: This parameter specifies if commands are transmitted as a secure message for each of the association groups. this parameter is only used when the device is included in security mode (either s0 or s2).  the values are bitmasks that can be added up to select several options

Multi-Level Switch Set Values For Pushbu.label: Multi-Level Switch Set Values For Pushbutton 1
Multi-Level Switch Set Values For Pushbu.description: Byte 1: enable / disable byte 2: upper switch value byte 3: lower switch value byte 4: not used – must be set to 0

Duration of Dimming.label: Duration of Dimming
Duration of Dimming.description: This parameter specifies the duration of a full regulation of the light from 0% to 100%. a regulation of the light with 1% will take 1/100 of the specified duration. this is used when a pushbutton is held-down for controlling the dimming, and when the dimming is fulfilled from other Z-Wave devices

Colour Commands For Pushbutton 1 LED Ind.label: Colour Commands For Pushbutton 1 LED Indication
Colour Commands For Pushbutton 1 LED Ind.description: This parameter specifies how command class switch color commands are handled

Off Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbu.label: Off Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbutton 1
Off Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbu.description: This parameter specifies the saturation levels for the red, green and blue leds, when off status is indicated. (default is the off-state indicated as a low white light on 5%). byte 1: colour saturation, red. byte 2: colour saturation, green. byte 3: colour saturation, blue. byte 4: LED control

Timer Value For Pushbutton 2.label: Timer Value For Pushbutton 2
Timer Value For Pushbutton 2.description: This parameter specifies the time used in previous configuration parameter. this parameter is only applicable if previous parameter has value 1 or 2

Binary Switch Set Support For Pushbutton.label: Binary Switch Set Support For Pushbutton 2
Binary Switch Set Support For Pushbutton.description: This parameter specifies how received binary switch set commands are handled

Colour Commands For Pushbutton 2 LED Ind.label: Colour Commands For Pushbutton 2 LED Indication
Colour Commands For Pushbutton 2 LED Ind.description: This parameter specifies how command class switch color commands is handled

On Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbut.label: On Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbutton 2
On Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbut.description: This parameter specifies the saturation levels for the red, green and blue leds, when on status is indicated. (default is the on-state indicated by a 50% blue colour). byte 1: colour saturation, red. byte 2: colour saturation, green. byte 3: colour saturation, blue. byte 4: LED control

Pushbutton 3 Functionality.label: Pushbutton 3 Functionality
Pushbutton 3 Functionality.description: This parameter specifies the functionality of pushbutton 3

Binary Switch Set Support For Pushbutton.label: Binary Switch Set Support For Pushbutton 3
Binary Switch Set Support For Pushbutton.description: This parameter specifies how received binary switch set commands are handled

Colour Commands For Pushbutton 3 LED Ind.label: Colour Commands For Pushbutton 3 LED Indication
Colour Commands For Pushbutton 3 LED Ind.description: This parameter specifies how command class switch color commands is handled

Off Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbu.label: Off Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbutton 3
Off Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbu.description: This parameter specifies the saturation levels for the red, green and blue leds, when off status is indicated. (default is the off-state indicated as a low white light on 5%). byte 1: colour saturation, red. byte 2: colour saturation, green. byte 3: colour saturation, blue. byte 4: LED control

Pushbutton 4 Functionality.label: Pushbutton 4 Functionality
Pushbutton 4 Functionality.description: This parameter specifies the functionality of pushbutton 4

Binary Switch Set Support For Pushbutton.label: Binary Switch Set Support For Pushbutton 4
Binary Switch Set Support For Pushbutton.description: This parameter specifies how received binary switch set commands are handled

Colour Commands For Pushbutton 4 LED Ind.label: Colour Commands For Pushbutton 4 LED Indication
Colour Commands For Pushbutton 4 LED Ind.description: This parameter specifies how command class switch color commands are handled

Off Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbu.label: Off Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbutton 4
Off Indication Rgb-saturation For Pushbu.description: This parameter specifies the saturation levels for the red, green and blue leds, when off status is indicated. (default is the off-state indicated as a low white light on 5%). byte 1: colour saturation, red. byte 2: colour saturation, green. byte 3: colour saturation, blue. byte 4: LED control

Double-activation Functionality.label: Double-activation Functionality
Double-activation Functionality.description: This parameter specifies the reaction when double-activating the pushbuttons

Escape Return Mode.label: Escape Return Mode
Escape Return Mode.description: 0x00 = off, 0xff = on default is 0x00 or off enables the escape return mode of operation for the lock

Power On State.label: Power On State
Power On State.description: When power is restored, the switch reverts to either on, off, or last level. example of how the values are used: 0 = off, 1-100 = specific % on. entering a value of 101 = returns the switch to the level before the power outage. this parameter can be changed at the config button

Led Indicator Color.label: Led Indicator Color
Led Indicator Color.description: This will set the default color of the LED bar. the color is calculated by using a hue color circle (value / 255 * 360). see website for more info. this parameter can be changed at the config button

Led Indicator Intensity (when Off).label: Led Indicator Intensity (when Off)
Led Indicator Intensity (when Off).description: This is the intensity of the LED bar when the switch is off. example of how the values are used: 0 = off, 1 = low, 5 = medium, 10 = high. this parameter can be changed at the config button

Ramp Rate.label: Ramp Rate
Ramp Rate.description: How fast or slow the light turns on when you press the switch 1x to bring from on to off or off to on. example of how the values are used: 0 = instant on, 1 = 1 second, 100 = 100 seconds. a value of 101 keeps this parameter in sync with parameter 1

Default Level (local).label: Default Level (local)
Default Level (local).description: Default dim level for the switch when pressed locally (at the switch). example of how the values are used: 0 = switch will return to level it was prior to being off, 1 = 1%, 100 = 100%. this parameter can be changed at the config button

Temperature.label: Temperature
Temperature.description: Value desired (1 to 9 °c in increments of 1°c)

Association Behavior.label: Association Behavior
Association Behavior.description: When should the switch send commands to associated devices

Reset to Factory Defaults.label: Reset to Factory Defaults
Reset to Factory Defaults.description: 01 = lock will execute reset to factory. no default value

System Type.label: System Type
System Type.description: Sets the system type. standard or heat pump

Fan Type.label: Fan Type
Fan Type.description: Sets the fan type. electric (fan w/heat) or gas (no fan w/heat)

Sensor Operation Mode.label: Sensor Operation Mode
Sensor Operation Mode.description: This parameter defines if the internal magnet sensor or the external terminal input is detected and used to issue alarm notification. there is always one input active only. the other sensor input the deactivated

Sensor State Polarity.label: Sensor State Polarity
Sensor State Polarity.description: This parameter defines the polarity of the magnet sensor

Active Power Reports.label: Active Power Reports
Active Power Reports.description: The parameter defines the power level change that will result in a new power report being sent. the value is a percentage of the previous report

State After Power Restored.label: State After Power Restored
State After Power Restored.description: The state the switch should return to once power is restored after power failure

Association Group 2 Settings.label: Association Group 2 Settings
Association Group 2 Settings.description: Configure the Basic Set value. determine the Basic Set value to control other Z-Wave devices directly when magnet is away or near

Central Scene Notifications.label: Central Scene Notifications
Central Scene Notifications.description: This parameter can be used for disabling central scene notifications

Parameter 6.label: Parameter 6
Parameter 6.description: Set whether to remember the last status of relay 2

Parameter 4.label: Parameter 4
Parameter 4.description: Operations mode for push buttons controlling the output

Degree Mode.label: Degree Mode
Degree Mode.description: Degree mode (c/f) floor and air temperature, as well as set point and all parameters will be indicated in the chosen mode. factory default value is degrees celsius (0)

Humidity Threshold.label: Humidity Threshold
Humidity Threshold.description: Humidity difference to send to controller, %. this parameter determines the change in humidity level in % resulting in humidity sensors report being sent to the gateway. from 2% to 25% can be selected. use the value 0 if there is a need to stop sending the reports. the factory default value is 2

Build Number.label: Build Number
Build Number.description: The jenkins build number for this fw

Percentage Threshold of Power Report.label: Percentage Threshold of Power Report
Percentage Threshold of Power Report.description: Power percentage threshold to be interpreted, when change value of the load power exceeds the setting threshold, the smart plug will send meter report to association device (group lifeline)

Weekday.label: Weekday
Weekday.description: Week day. this parameter allows manually adjustment of the day of the week in case if the thermostat is not connected to any Z-Wave gateway or parameter 09 (auto-correction) is selected as 0

Parameter 1.label: Parameter 1
Parameter 1.description: Enable/disable central scene notifications for 2x-5x button presses

Parameter 3.label: Parameter 3
Parameter 3.description: Interval of active energy meter reports in minutes

Auto Turn-off Timer For Relay 1.label: Auto Turn-off Timer For Relay 1
Auto Turn-off Timer For Relay 1.description: Use this parameter to set the time a􀈇er which you want the device connected to relay 1 to automatically turn off once it has been turned on. the number entered as value corresponds to the number of minutes

Auto Turn-off Timer For Relay 2.label: Auto Turn-off Timer For Relay 2
Auto Turn-off Timer For Relay 2.description: Use this parameter to set the time a􀈇er which you want the device connected to relay 2 to automatically turn off once it has been turned on. the number entered as value corresponds to the number of minutes

Auto Turn-off Timer For Relay.label: Auto Turn-off Timer For Relay
Auto Turn-off Timer For Relay.description: Use this parameter to set the time a􀈇er which you want the relay to automatically turn off once it has been turned on. the number entered as value corresponds to the number of minutes

Hold1 Control Mode.label: Hold1 Control Mode
Hold1 Control Mode.description: Hold control mode for touch button 1

Hold3 Control Mode.label: Hold3 Control Mode
Hold3 Control Mode.description: Hold control mode for touch button 3

Hold5 Control Mode.label: Hold5 Control Mode
Hold5 Control Mode.description: Hold control mode for touch button 5

Click2 Control Mode.label: Click2 Control Mode
Click2 Control Mode.description: Click control mode for touch button 2

Click4 Control Mode.label: Click4 Control Mode
Click4 Control Mode.description: Click control mode for touch button 4

Relay Inverse Group1.label: Relay Inverse Group1
Relay Inverse Group1.description: Group 1 relay inverse mode. the valid values are the following: 0, 12, 13, 14, 15, 21, 23, 24, 25, 31, 32, 34, 35, 41, 42, 43, 45, 51, 52, 53, 54

Relay Control Scenario1.label: Relay Control Scenario1
Relay Control Scenario1.description: Relays control by sensors group 1 0, 10000000 … 53112359 encoded as 8 digit value (abcdefgh): a: relay number (1.. 5) b: control mode (0-temperature sensor, 1-humidity sensor, 2-light sensor, 3-time control) c: state change condition relative to the value in hgfe value field ( 0-lower than, 1-higher than) d: state change, 0- switch off, 1- switch on efgh: condition value   sensor value for control modes 0-2   time of day for control mode 3. ef represents hour (0..23), gh represents minutes (0..59)

Relay Control Scenario3.label: Relay Control Scenario3
Relay Control Scenario3.description: Relays control by sensors group 3 0, 10000000 … 53112359 encoded as 8 digit value (abcdefgh): a: relay number (1.. 5) b: control mode (0-temperature sensor, 1-humidity sensor, 2-light sensor, 3-time control) c: state change condition relative to the value in hgfe value field ( 0-lower than, 1-higher than) d: state change, 0- switch off, 1- switch on efgh: condition value   sensor value for control modes 0-2   time of day for control mode 3. ef represents hour (0..23), gh represents minutes (0..59)

Relay Control Scenario5.label: Relay Control Scenario5
Relay Control Scenario5.description: Relays control by sensors group 5 0, 10000000 … 53112359 encoded as 8 digit value (abcdefgh): a: relay number (1.. 5) b: control mode (0-temperature sensor, 1-humidity sensor, 2-light sensor, 3-time control) c: state change condition relative to the value in hgfe value field ( 0-lower than, 1-higher than) d: state change, 0- switch off, 1- switch on efgh: condition value   sensor value for control modes 0-2   time of day for control mode 3. ef represents hour (0..23), gh represents minutes (0..59)

Relay Control Scenario7.label: Relay Control Scenario7
Relay Control Scenario7.description: Relays control by sensors group 7. 0, 10000000 … 53112359 encoded as 8 digit value (abcdefgh): a: relay number (1.. 5) b: control mode (0-temperature sensor, 1-humidity sensor, 2-light sensor, 3-time control) c: state change condition relative to the value in hgfe value field ( 0-lower than, 1-higher than) d: state change, 0- switch off, 1- switch on efgh: condition value   sensor value for control modes 0-2   time of day for control mode 3. ef represents hour (0..23), gh represents minutes (0..59)

Relay Control Scenario9.label: Relay Control Scenario9
Relay Control Scenario9.description: Relays control by sensors group 9 0, 10000000 … 53112359 encoded as 8 digit value (abcdefgh): a: relay number (1.. 5) b: control mode (0-temperature sensor, 1-humidity sensor, 2-light sensor, 3-time control) c: state change condition relative to the value in hgfe value field ( 0-lower than, 1-higher than) d: state change, 0- switch off, 1- switch on efgh: condition value   sensor value for control modes 0-2   time of day for control mode 3. ef represents hour (0..23), gh represents minutes (0..59)

Parameter 10.label: Parameter 10
Parameter 10.description: This parameter allows to check motor factory data: gearbox ratio and motor nominal speed(read-only)

Parameter 12.label: Parameter 12
Parameter 12.description: Get motor factory data: obstacle detection max level, battery motor and soft start/stop max(read-only)

Parameter 8.label: Parameter 8
Parameter 8.description: Set a number of moves to start identification. note: when wiggle ends, an unsolicited report to lifeline destination with t he value 0 will be sent.  if module receives control command in cc multilevel switch/basic automatically stops the wiggle

Reset Parameter.label: Reset Parameter
Reset Parameter.description: 0 – nothing happens 0x55555555 – completely factory reset sensor and send device reset locally notification. all other values – reset all parameter settings to their default settings

Range Test After Double Click.label: Range Test After Double Click
Range Test After Double Click.description: Allows to enable the activation of a Z-Wave range test with double clicking the tamper switch

Basic Command \"off Event\" Value.label: Basic Command "off Event" Value
Basic Command \"off Event\" Value.description: This is the basic command value sent in case of "off" event

Minimum Humidity Change to Report.label: Minimum Humidity Change to Report
Minimum Humidity Change to Report.description: This value defines the minimum change of humidity to cause an unsolicited report of humidity to the central controller using lifeline. if the value is set to 0, there will be no reports sent to the controller, when the humidity changes. however, periodic reports, managed by configuration parameter 18, may still be active

Overheat Trigger Value.label: Overheat Trigger Value
Overheat Trigger Value.description: Configure overheat report trigger value. “higher byte 0x00 represents celsius °c unit, 0x01 represents fahrenheit °f unit

Parameter No. 30 – Restore State On Powe.label: Parameter No. 30 – Restore State On Power Failure
Parameter No. 30 – Restore State On Powe.description: Values (size is 1-byte dec):  • default value 1 • 1 – enabled (the device will restore state on power failure) • 0 – disabled (the device will not restore state on power failure and will remain off)

Remember Relays State.label: Remember Relays State
Remember Relays State.description: This parameter determines the state of relays after power supply failure (e.g. power outage). for auto off and flashing modes the parameter is not relevant and the relay will always remain switched off

First Channel – Reaction to Input Change.label: First Channel – Reaction to Input Change in Delayed/ Auto Off Modes
First Channel – Reaction to Input Change.description: This parameter determines how the device reacts when changing state of s1 input in timed modes for first channel

S1 Input – Switch On Value Sent to 2nd A.label: S1 Input – Switch On Value Sent to 2nd Association Group
S1 Input – Switch On Value Sent to 2nd A.description: This parameter defines value sent with switch on command to devices in 2nd association group when using s1 input

S1 Input – Double Click Value Sent to 2n.label: S1 Input – Double Click Value Sent to 2nd Association Group
S1 Input – Double Click Value Sent to 2n.description: This parameter defines value sent with double click command to devices in 2nd association group when using s1 input

S1 Input – Switch Type.label: S1 Input – Switch Type
S1 Input – Switch Type.description: This parameter defines as what type the device should treat the switch connected to the s1 terminal

S2 Input – Scenes Sent.label: S2 Input – Scenes Sent
S2 Input – Scenes Sent.description: This parameter determines which actions result in sending scene ids assigned to them. values can be combined (e.g. 1+2=3 means that scenes for single and double click are sent). enabling scenes for triple click disables entering the device in learning mode by triple clicking

Door Lock Mode.label: Door Lock Mode
Door Lock Mode.description: It means door lock’s locking mode(auto/manual)

Handing Control.label: Handing Control
Handing Control.description: The configuration parameter 10 is a read/write parameter with a one-byte field. when this parameter is read, it will return the handing of the lock. when this parameter is written, it will run a handing operation. when written with a value of 0x01, it will cause the lock to cycle through locking and unlocking until it determines the correct handing. it is suggested that this operation occur while the door is opened so that no obstructions will be in the way for the operation. after the completion of the handing process, a configuration report message will be sent back to the requestor. it will contain a non-zero value for success or a zero value for failure

User Program Button Control.label: User Program Button Control
User Program Button Control.description: The configuration parameter 3 is a read/write parameter with a one-byte field, used to control the user program button. if set to on, the program button is available for user code maintenance. if set to off, the program button is not available for user code maintenance

Factory Default Control.label: Factory Default Control
Factory Default Control.description: The configuration parameter 40 is a write only parameter with a one-byte field, used to request the lock to perform a factory reset back to its default state. this control will cause the lock to be removed from the network, placing the lock back to its default state. when a read is issued for this parameter, a 0 will be returned

Keyfunction.label: Keyfunction
Keyfunction.description: Parameter=1，size=1， value=0 up button: on   down button: off value=1 up button: off   down button: on  value=2 up button: on/off  down button: on/off

Association Reports.label: Association Reports
Association Reports.description: Parameter=16，size=1 values: 0 –  Z-Wave control：binary switch report manual control: Basic Set report  1 –  Z-Wave control：binary switch report manual control:  binary switch report

Enable Or Disable Local / Z-Wave Control.label: Enable Or Disable Local / Z-Wave Control
Enable Or Disable Local / Z-Wave Control.description: Enable or disable local / Z-Wave control  parameter=15，size=1，value=0 disable (when paddle pressed switch will not turn light on or off but it will still control the light via Z-Wave and it will change LED indicator status and on/off/multilevel status when paddle is pressed) value=1 enable (normal operation like now) value = 2 disable local and Z-Wave control (led and on/off status will still change if paddle pressed) >> make sure that status is still reported and LED indicator changes when Z-Wave control is disabled  default = 1

Led Indicator Brightness.label: Led Indicator Brightness
Led Indicator Brightness.description: Led indicator brightness parameter=24，size=1，value=0 bright (100%) value=1 medium (60%)  value=2 low (30%)  default =1

Led Indicator Color For Lower Paddle Rem.label: Led Indicator Color For Lower Paddle Remote Cont
Led Indicator Color For Lower Paddle Rem.description: Paramter no: 3(0x03)， size=1 byte (default=0)  value: 00 white  value: 01 blue  value: 02 green  value: 03 red  value: 04 magenta  value: 05 yellow  value: 06 cyan

On/Off Paddle Orientation.label: On/Off Paddle Orientation
On/Off Paddle Orientation.description: Choose if you want the upper paddle to turn the light on or turn the light off when tapped

Auto Turn-off Timer.label: Auto Turn-off Timer
Auto Turn-off Timer.description: Use this parameter to enable or disable the auto turn-off timer function (the time after which you want the switch to automatically turn off once it has been turned on)

Smart Bulb Mode: Enable/Disable Paddle /.label: Smart Bulb Mode: Enable/Disable Paddle / Z-Wave Control
Smart Bulb Mode: Enable/Disable Paddle /.description: Enable or disable local on/off control. if enabled, you’ll only be able to control the connected light via Z-Wave. scenes and other functionality will still be available through paddles

Auto Turn-on Timer.label: Auto Turn-on Timer
Auto Turn-on Timer.description: Use this parameter to enable or disable the auto turn-on timer function (the time after which you want the switch to automatically turn on once it has been turned off)

3-way Switch Type.label: 3-way Switch Type
3-way Switch Type.description: Choose the type of 3-way switch you want to use with this dimmer in a 3-way set-up. changing this setting can allow you to control brightness and dim the light from both 3-way locations. use a regular momentary switch (like the zooz zac99 accessory switch) if value is set to 2

Reporting Behavior For Smart Bulb Mode.label: Reporting Behavior For Smart Bulb Mode
Reporting Behavior For Smart Bulb Mode.description: Set reporting behavior for disabled physical control

Single Tap Behavior.label: Single Tap Behavior
Single Tap Behavior.description: Choose what you'd like the dimmer to do when you tap the upper paddle once

Led Indicator Status.label: Led Indicator Status
Led Indicator Status.description: Synchronization of load power and LED indicator

Child Lockout Enable.label: Child Lockout Enable
Child Lockout Enable.description: Child lockout feature can enabled and disabled local control

Enable Or Disable Output Control.label: Enable Or Disable Output Control
Enable Or Disable Output Control.description: Parameter=11，size=1，value=0 disable local button and external switch control enable Z-Wave control value=1 enable local button and external switch control enable Z-Wave control value = 2 disable local button and external switch control

Disabled Relay Behavior.label: Disabled Relay Behavior
Disabled Relay Behavior.description: Disabled relay behavior parameter=21,size=1 value=0 report on/off and multilevel status when paddle is pressed and change LED indicator status and parameter 15 is set to value 0 or 2 (output control disabled) according to setting in parameter 20. value=1 don’t report on/off or multilevel status or and change LED indicator status when paddle is pressed and parameter 15 is set to value 0 or 2 (output control disabled).   default = 0

Custom Brightness Level.label: Custom Brightness Level
Custom Brightness Level.description: Custom brightness level - in this parameter define default brightness level the switch will turn on to from main switch or regular switch in 3-way when pressed upper paddle once. parameter: 18 size: 1 byte dec values 0-99 0 - last brightness level 1-99 custom brightness level default = 0

Night Light On Duration.label: Night Light On Duration
Night Light On Duration.description: Range: 0~1. value = 0 night light on for 10 seconds (default). value = 1 night light on for 30 seconds

Enable Tamper Alarm Report.label: Enable Tamper Alarm Report
Enable Tamper Alarm Report.description: This parameter setting is used to enable/disable the device cover removed tamper alarm report. range: 0~1. value = 0 - disable the tamper alarm report. value = 1 - enable the tamper alarm report. (default)

Motion Alarm Retrigger Modes.label: Motion Alarm Retrigger Modes
Motion Alarm Retrigger Modes.description: This option will select how the motion alarm retrigger duration timer (cpn#1) to be reset. range: 0~1. value = 0, in this mode, the motion alarm retrigger duration timer (cpn#1) will be reset to zero once the motion event is detected. hence, the motion alarm retrigger duration timer will start recounting which extends the retrigger duration. this mode will extend the battery life and reduce unnecessary motion alarm reports (default). value = 1, in this mode, the motion alarm retrigger duration timer (cpn#1) would not be reset once the motion event has detected. the motion alarm reports will be enabled to send once the motion alarm retrigger duration timer has expired. in this mode, it will report the motion alarm event with greater fidelity. this setting might be used where the device will be used for automation tasks

Low Battery Setting.label: Low Battery Setting
Low Battery Setting.description: Low warning message when battery level reaches this value

Luminance Change Threshold.label: Luminance Change Threshold
Luminance Change Threshold.description: This parameter determines the change in lux of light intensity level resulting in sending luminance report. range: 0~60 (lux). default: 50. value = 0 disable luminance value scanning, no report. note: the luminance value is scanned every 5 seconds. a luminance report will be sent if a change over the set threshold value is detected

Temperature Scheduled Report Interval.label: Temperature Scheduled Report Interval
Temperature Scheduled Report Interval.description: The temperature value report interval time is based on 30 minutes per kick. the value n related to the time in minutes is n x 30 minutes. range: 0~120. default: 6 (6x30 =180 minutes). value = 0 disable temperature scheduled report

Energy Reports.label: Energy Reports
Energy Reports.description: The energy level change that will result in a new energy report being sent (% of previous report). example of how the values work: 0 = disabled, 10 = 10% of previous report, 100 = 100% of previous report

Led Indicator Intensity.label: Led Indicator Intensity
Led Indicator Intensity.description: This will set the intensity of the LED bar (ie: how bright it is). example of how the values work: 0 = off, 1 = low, 5 = medium, 10 = high. this parameter can be set without a hub from the configuration button
